```{r function}
# function that takes the gdb output format as string and produces an r data object (LLM-generated)
parse_coeffs <- function(output) {
  x <- str_c(output, collapse = " ")

  number <- "[+-]?(?:\\d+\\.?\\d*|\\.\\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\\d+)?"

  # Extract the contents of coeffs = { ... }
  coeffs_text <- str_match(
    x,
    "coeffs\\s*=\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}"
  )[, 2]

  if (is.na(coeffs_text)) {
    stop("Could not find the coeffs struct.")
  }

  # Extract name/value pairs from coeffs
  coeffs <- str_match_all(
    coeffs_text,
    str_c("(\\w+)\\s*=\\s*(", number, ")")
  )[[1]]

  result <- set_names(
    as.list(as.numeric(coeffs[, 3])),
    coeffs[, 2]
  )

  # Extract top-level position, excluding position_unc
  position <- str_match(
    x,
    str_c("\\bposition\\s*=\\s*(", number, ")")
  )[, 2]

  if (!is.na(position)) {
    result$position <- as.numeric(position)
  }

  return(result)
}

# batch access for the above function, also llm generated
parse_gdb_batch <- function(x) {
  # Split before each "(gdb) print ..."
  blocks <- str_split(
    str_c(x, collapse = "\n"),
    "(?=\\(gdb\\)\\s+print)",
    simplify = FALSE
  )[[1]]

  blocks <- blocks[str_detect(blocks, "\\$\\d+\\s*=\\s*\\{")]

  # Extract the index from validRegressions.at(n)
  indices <- str_match(
    blocks,
     "validRegressions(?:\\.|->)at\\((\\d+)\\)"
  )[, 2]

  result <- map(
    blocks,
    parse_coeffs
  )

  names(result) <- paste0("reg_", indices)

  result
}

# peak fit function
q_reg = function(coeffs, x){
    x = x - coeffs$x0
    b0 = coeffs$b0
    b1 = coeffs$b1

    bool_b2 = (x < 0) * 1
    bool_b3 = (x >= 0) * 1
    b23 = coeffs$b2 * bool_b2 + coeffs$b3 * bool_b3
    
    exp(b0 + b1 * x + b23 * x * x)
}

# colour palette for up to 25 different regressions in one plot
c25 <- c(
  "dodgerblue2", "#E31A1C", # red
  "green4",
  "#6A3D9A", # purple
  "#FF7F00", # orange
  "black", "gold1",
  "skyblue2", "#FB9A99", # lt pink
  "palegreen2",
  "#CAB2D6", # lt purple
  "#FDBF6F", # lt orange
  "gray70", "khaki2",
  "maroon", "orchid1", "deeppink1", "blue1", "steelblue4",
  "darkturquoise", "green1", "yellow4", "yellow3",
  "darkorange4", "brown"
)

# use single regression to produce a function plot element
plot_coeff = function(coeffs, x_axis, colour){
  geom_function(fun = q_reg, args = list(coeffs = coeffs),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    xlim = range(x_axis, na.rm = TRUE), 
    colour = colour)
}

# batch transform a list of regressions into a list of geoms
geom_qreg_batch = function(batch, x_axis){
  
  # max of 25 colours
  if(length(batch) > 25){
    stop("Error: At most 25 regressions can be plotted at once")
  }

  regNames = names(batch)

  # index into c25
  i = 1

  # modify return list
  ret = list()

  for(reg in batch){
    funcFit = plot_coeff(reg, x_axis, c25[i])
    name = regNames[i]
    
    i = i + 1

    ret[[regNames[i]]] <- funcFit
  }
  return(ret)
}
```
